limitations: Tested versions are informational, not a runtime whitelist. Play-region service success is user-reported, not an exhaustive device or backend test.
Dynamic script changes can cause guarded rules to skip.
All toggle combinations were not separately verified visually on a phone.
No full business-function regression was performed.
No concrete baseline bottom Sport campaign was captured; no visual comparison claim for a specific campaign.
Third-party device plugins and other advertising placements are not exhaustively covered.
Initial selection hook signature verified statically; no standalone log of that selection was captured. The logged mainland-startup hit confirms real CN detection on restart.
Play built-in Mine page has Prize instead of Assets; an absent Assets entry stays untouched. Native-hidden entries are not forced visible.
Device smoke checks used the existing selected switches; each option was not separately toggled off/on and visually regressed.
Previous user reports of device lists and sync remain historical; this build did not repeat a full login, privacy or backend/device regression.
